items.translation: 请告诉我您的房间号码。

explanations:
`Come in.` 是让人进屋最常用的说法，也用来回应敲门。常见错误：
• "Come into" → into 后面必须接宾语（come into the room）
• "Enter in" → enter 本身不接 in
相关：Come on in.（快进来，更热情）/ After you.（您先请）

items.sentence: I have a reservation under the name Chen.
items.translation: 我以陈这个名字订了房间。
explanations:
酒店前台报预订名的标准句。`have a reservation` = 有预订。常见错误：
• "I **reserved** a room" → 也正确但 hotel 场景用 have a reservation 更自然
• "I have reservation" → 可数名词要加 a
`under the name Chen` = 以…名义预订，介词用 under 不用 with/in。

sentenceAudio.text: I have a reservation under the name Chen.

items.sentence: What time is check-out tomorrow morning?
explanations:
酒店场景问退房时间。`check-out`（退房）对应 check-in（入住）。常见错误：
• "What time **is it** check-out" → 直接 What time is + 事件，不加 it
• "when is checkout" → 也可以，但 what time 更精确到几点
`tomorrow morning` 时间状语，前面不加 in/on。同系列：this morning / yesterday morning。

sentenceAudio.text: What time is check-out tomorrow morning?

items.sentence: Could I have a room with a view?
items.translation: 我能要一间看得见风景的房间吗？
hints: 一间能看到风景的房间
explanations: `Could I have...` 酒店委婉索取句式（同 Could we have / May I have）。

`a room with a view` = 景观房。with 引导后置定语修饰 room。常见错误：
• "a view room" → 不地道，用 a room with a view
• "a room **has** a view" → 定语用 with，不能直接接动词

sentenceAudio.text: Could I have a room with a view?

items.sentence: The air conditioner doesn't seem to work.
explanations: `the air conditioner` 空调（口语常缩略为 the AC）。

`doesn't seem to work` = 似乎坏了。seem to do = 看起来…。常见错误：
• "doesn't seems to work" → 助动词后接原形 seem
• "doesn't work" → 少了 seem 的委婉，直接说坏了语气太绝对

sentenceAudio.text: The air conditioner doesn't seem to work.

items.sentence: Could you send someone up to fix it?
items.translation: 你能派人上来修一下吗？
explanations:
酒店报修用语。`send someone up` = 派人上来（up 指上楼到客房）。常见错误：
• "send someone **to** up" → up 是副词，直接接在宾语后
• "send up someone" → 宾语长时 up 放后更自然
`to fix it` 不定式表目的 = 来修理。同义：to repair it / to take a look at it.
distractors: Can you to send someone up

sentenceAudio.text: Could you send someone up to fix it?

items.sentence: Could I see your boarding pass, please?
items.translation: 请出示您的登机牌好吗？
explanations: 机场登机口查验登机牌的用语。`boarding pass` = 登机牌（boarding card 同义）。
`your boarding pass,` 名词短语作宾语，后接 please 表请求。注意 boarding pass 中间不加空格外的词：不说 boarding **the** pass。
`please?` 放在句尾升调表请求。也可前置：Please, could I see…?

sentenceAudio.text: Could I see your boarding pass, please?

items.sentence: How many bags are you checking in?
explanations:
值机柜台问行李数。`bags` 口语指行李箱。常见错误：
• "How **much** bags" → bags 可数用 many
• "How many **baggage**" → baggage 不可数，不用 many 修饰
`check in` 此处指「托运行李」（check in bags）。注意拆开使用：checking **in** 的 in 不能丢。

sentenceAudio.text: How many bags are you checking in?

explanations:
飞机、公交、火车、船这类「登上去」的交通工具用 `get on`。常见错误：
• "Get in the plane" → in 指进到某个内部空间，登机用 on
• "Get the plane" → 少了 on，意思变成得到飞机
